questions.text: What is the unit of force?
The forces in Newton’s third law act on different bodies.
What force accelerates a 3 kg mass at 2 m/s²?
What acceleration does a 12 kg mass experience under a 6 N force?
What does the law of inertia state?
options: Without a net external force, rest or uniform straight-line motion continues.
Every force has equal opposite force on same body.
Force equals mass divided by acceleration.
questions.correctAnswer: Without a net external force, rest or uniform straight-line motion continues.

questions.text: Calculate the force for m = 10 kg and a = 0.5 m/s².
For the same force, the larger mass accelerates more.
What effect can a force have?
options: Change speed or direction, or deform a body
Change density without changing anything else
questions.correctAnswer: Change speed or direction, or deform a body
